author.description:
Timo started trading currencies as a retail trader in Ho Chi Minh City and kept running into the same problem: broker reviews described the brand, not the company that opened his account. Two brokers with near-identical websites turned out to be served by entities in very different jurisdictions.

He founded FX Trading Today to research brokers the way a careful trader would: find the legal entity, check it on the regulator's own register, then move real money through the payment methods people in each country actually use.

Today he leads the review process, signs off every score and runs the account, deposit and withdrawal tests from Vietnam and Thailand himself. Reviews he did not test personally say so.

meta.fxt_short_bio: Timo founded FX Trading Today to answer one question for traders in Southeast Asia: which company actually holds your money? He leads every broker review and personally runs the deposit and withdrawal tests.

fxt_principles: Never accepts payment, gifts or funded accounts from brokers for a review.
Tests with his own money through the same sign-up flow as any reader.
Publishes the test date on every finding and updates it when conditions change.
meta.fxt_disclosure: FX Trading Today may earn a commission when readers open an account through some links. Timo does not see commercial terms before he scores a broker.

brokers.title: Exness
brokers.excerpt: Low entry cost and fast local payments in our Vietnam tests, served through an offshore entity.
brokers.summary: In our sample tests from Vietnam, local deposits cleared in minutes and all three withdrawals arrived within four days. Costs on the Standard account were competitive. The trade-off is regulatory: clients in Southeast Asia are onboarded by an offshore entity, so protections differ from the EU entity.

Low $10 minimum deposit on Standard accounts
Wide account range, including a cent account for small test balances
MT4, MT5 and a proprietary web terminal
cons: Southeast Asian clients are served by an offshore entity, not the EU or UK entity
Very high leverage is available, which increases risk for new traders

brokers.content:
Quick facts

Trader verdict

In our sample tests from Vietnam, local deposits cleared in minutes and all three withdrawals arrived within four days. Costs on the Standard account were competitive. The trade-off is regulatory: clients in Southeast Asia are onboarded by an offshore entity, so protections differ from the EU entity.

Most relevant for New traders, Small test balances, Active traders, Experienced traders

Regulation and client protection

The brand is not the company that holds your money. For clients in each country, this is the chain we trace and verify on official registers.

Trading costs and execution

Spreads are averages we observed on EUR/USD across five sessions, including the London open, not the advertised minimum.

Platforms

Deposit and withdrawal

Payment options depend on the entity and the country. We move real money through local methods and time each step.

Account types

Pros and cons

What worked in our research

  • Local QR and bank deposits cleared in minutes in our sample tests
  • Low $10 minimum deposit on Standard accounts
  • Wide account range, including a cent account for small test balances
  • MT4, MT5 and a proprietary web terminal

What to weigh carefully

  • Southeast Asian clients are served by an offshore entity, not the EU or UK entity
  • Very high leverage is available, which increases risk for new traders
  • No TradingView integration observed

Research evidence

Test status by country. Evidence pages show timestamps, amounts and redacted screenshots for each test.

How we evaluated this broker

  • Mapped which legal entity onboards clients in each market we cover, then looked it up on the regulator’s register.
  • Opened a live account, completed verification and recorded every step with timestamps.
  • Deposited and withdrew real money using local methods, and measured spreads across five sessions.
  • Scored six weighted categories. Commercial relationships were not part of the scoring.

Final verdict

A practical option for traders in Vietnam who value fast local payments and a low entry point. Read the regulation section closely: the entity that serves you is not the one behind the brand's strongest licences.

evidence.excerpt: Every account, deposit, withdrawal and support step we recorded while testing Exness from Vietnam.

fxt_summary.title: Account registration
fxt_summary.detail: Email and phone verified in 6 min

fxt_timeline.title: Identity verified
fxt_timeline.note: National ID and proof of address accepted

fxt_deposits.steps:
2026-09-02 09:18 | Payment initiated in banking app
2026-09-02 09:19 | Bank confirmed payment
2026-09-02 09:20 | Trading account credited
fxt_deposits.note: The deposit appeared in the trading account about two minutes after the payment was confirmed in the banking app. No fee was shown by the broker or the bank.

fxt_deposits.steps:
2026-09-03 13:48 | Transfer sent from bank
2026-09-03 13:49 | Bank confirmed transfer
2026-09-03 14:02 | Trading account credited
fxt_deposits.note: The transfer required the payment reference to be copied exactly. Crediting took 14 minutes, the slowest of the three deposits.

fxt_deposits.steps:
2026-09-05 08:46 | Card payment authorised
2026-09-05 08:47 | Trading account credited
fxt_deposits.note: Card deposit was credited instantly. The card issuer applied no foreign transaction fee on this test; this can vary by issuer.

fxt_withdrawals.steps:
2026-09-06 09:14 | Withdrawal requested
2026-09-06 09:32 | Approved by broker
2026-09-06 09:45 | Funds received by bank
fxt_withdrawals.note: Approved automatically in 18 minutes and received 13 minutes later. Amount received matched the amount requested.

fxt_withdrawals.steps:
2026-09-08 15:02 | Withdrawal requested
2026-09-08 16:10 | Approved by broker
2026-09-09 08:40 | Funds received by bank
fxt_withdrawals.note: Requested on a weekday afternoon. The broker approved within about an hour, but the bank credited the funds the next morning, which suggests the delay was on the banking side.

fxt_withdrawals.steps:
2026-09-10 10:00 | Refund requested
2026-09-10 11:05 | Approved by broker
2026-09-13 11:20 | Refund posted to card
fxt_withdrawals.note: Card withdrawals are processed as refunds to the original card. The refund took three days to post, which is typical for card networks.

evidence.content:
Test summary

Test timeline

Deposit tests

Withdrawal tests

What happened during our test?

  • Deposit confirmation appeared approximately two minutes after the VietQR payment was completed.
  • The bank transfer deposit required the exact payment reference. A mistyped reference would likely have delayed crediting.
  • The first withdrawal was approved automatically; the second waited for manual approval of about an hour.
  • Support answered our live chat question about withdrawal limits in Vietnamese within four minutes.
